get.description:
Server-sent events: ``agent_event`` per timeline entry, ``status`` on change, ``end``
once the investigation is finished and every event has been sent.

schema.title: Response List Repositories Api History Repositories Get
Response List Batches Api History Repositories  Tracked Id  Batches Get
Response List Findings Api History Quality Get
Response Check Quality Api History Quality Check Post

get.description:
Similar failures, shown as history: never evidence, never a reason to change a status.

History matching is experimental and off by default (D-057): then only this
investigation's own fingerprints are returned, with no matches and no counts.

post.description:
The operator's confirmed resolution (D-051 ``human_confirmed``). It is shown with later
similar failures, and recorded on the timeline; the diagnosis and its status stay as they
are.

get.description:
How the run compares with the last comparable success, and the changes in between
ranked by correlation (never as the cause). ``null`` when there is no analysis.

schema.title: Response Investigation Changes Api Investigations  Investigation Id  Changes Get
Response Refresh Api Analytics Refresh Post

get.description:
Everything the dashboard shows, in one response (refreshing changed days first).

Recurring failures come from history matching, which is experimental and off by default
(D-057): then they are neither counted nor listed.

schema.title: Response Dashboard Api Analytics Dashboard Get

get.description: Tests with explicitly observed results, most concerning first.

The reliability of every test this investigation's log names, across the workspace.
Context only: it never changes the diagnosis or its status.

schema.title: Response Investigation Reliability Api Investigations  Investigation Id  Reliability Get

post.description:
Compare a later run with the proposal: is the change in that commit, did the same job
fail the same way? Read-only on GitHub; recorded and audited in Kensa.

ForgetIn.title: ForgetIn
ForgetIn.description:
Forget repository deletes everything Kensa holds about it; the request must repeat the
repository's full name, so it cannot happen by accident.

GitHubTarget.title: GitHubTarget
GitHubTarget.description: A failed job of a public GitHub Actions run, as returned by ``/api/github/lookup``.

GroupOut.title: GroupOut
GroupOut.description: One configuration the test ran in. ``verified`` only when every factor is known.
